name: Internet & cloud outages
summary: The 13 Nov US flight ground stop and the 12–13 Nov Microsoft 365 outage both ended over 48h ago; no new major outage
state: The FAA halted US departures from 15:54 to 20:15 ET on 13 Nov after a telecoms failure at air traffic control centres (Al Jazeera, 14 Nov). Microsoft said services had fully recovered from its worldwide Microsoft 365 outage on 13 Nov (Al Jazeera; Insurance Journal, 15 Nov). Both ended more than 48 hours before 16 Nov 11:40 UTC and searches found no new multi-hour outage, so the level returns to Normal.
for_you: No major cloud, payments or airline system outage is in progress. Service status pages remain the quickest check if an app or site stops working.
rubric_hit: No major multi-hour outage in the past 48h = Normal

sources.title: Al Jazeera — Microsoft says affected services fully recovered following worldwide outage
Insurance Journal — Microsoft says services fully restored after outage roiled world

why: A handful of cloud and CDN providers carry much of the internet; one bad update can halt airlines, banks and payments.
drivers: Software updates, configuration errors, attacks, power failures.

rubric.alert: Multi-hour global outage hitting payments, airlines or emergency services, ongoing or within 24h.
rubric.watch: A major cloud/CDN/payments outage > 2h in the past 48h.
rubric.normal: No major multi-hour outages in the past 48h.
